text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Kikuka Sho, the grand finale of the 
Classic road, became a dream three-way 
showdown among the Mejiros.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Among them, long-distance specialist 
Mejiro McQueen is poised for a surefire 
victory. Surpassing her sheer 
determination won't be an easy task.
